name: Morizono Rikka
source:
Hobbies: Gardening
Favorite Food: Japanese Confectionery
Hated Food: Spicy food
Affiliation: Kazami affiliated junior high class 3-2, the newspaper club.

A beautiful person in both personality and appearance, she has been called the school idol. While Kiyotaka is the formal owner of the official newspaper club, she is considered to be the director of events. Her meeting with Kiyotaka was very abrupt, literally appearing from the skies, claiming to have been his lover in a previous life.

[spoiler]In her route in D.C. III P.P, it is revealed that Ricca was Grandma Yoshino (Ricca Greenwood) in a past life with Kiyotaka as her husband when they first planted the magical Sakura tree over 100 years ago. She tells Sakura a story about her life as a magician. 

In D.C.III D.D Sakura gives her Kiyotaka wand. [/spoiler]
